$comment: Emission-factors catalog v0.1 (spec §7.4, §8.5). CO2 and CO2e are ALWAYS separate entries — CO2e is never derived from CO2 (rulebook C.5, D.6). Values taken VERBATIM from docs/research-notes.md §4 and the Data agent's DESNZ 'Outside of scopes' extraction. DESNZ direct-combustion factors: pollutant 'CO2' = the CO2 component of DESNZ's CO2/CH4/N2O split; pollutant 'CO2e' = DESNZ's published total (all in kg per litre / m³ / tonne). Biogenic entries (biogenic:true, pollutant 'biogenic_CO2') come from DESNZ's 'Outside of scopes' sheet (column 'kg CO2e of CO2 per unit', net CV basis) — the true biogenic combustion CO2 that DESNZ nets to zero in Scope 1. IPCC 2006 CO2 factors are per-energy (kg CO2/TJ = kg CO2/GJ × 1000 → stored as kg_co2_per_gj, e.g. 73,300 kg/TJ = 73.3 kg/GJ) on a net/LHV basis. Electricity factors are region+year tagged (region_year_specific). Units: see the emission_intensity units in data/units.json. See src/lib/data/schemas.ts (emissionFactorSchema).

emission_factors.notes: ILLUSTRATIVE region+year example, NOT a global default (rulebook C.6). DESNZ 2025 UK grid intensity published as 0.177 kgCO2e/kWh = 177 gCO2e/kWh (CO2 component 174.89, CH4 0.9, N2O 1.22 gCO2e/kWh). Stored in g/kWh to match the unit id (×1000 from DESNZ's kg/kWh — an exact rescale, verbatim value in this note). ~15% lower than 2024. Add DESNZ's separate T&D factor for a full consumption-basis figure.
